summary: Round-3 repair of the loop-carried merge and lowering-ordering census family. (1) The stage plan (a100c/plan/stages.py) now recognizes two more carried-update forms as merge rules: the extremum binops (acc = tl.maximum/tl.minimum(acc, term), either operand order, all eight TIR min/max codes) and the guarded extremum select (acc = tl.where(term < acc, term, acc) and its operand/direction variants, requiring the compare's operands to be the select's own two values with the carried value on one side). A rebinding that drops the carried value, a compound-condition select (the arg-select pair) and unrecognized forms keep the located 'escapes without a merge rule' refusal. (2) The chunk a SCALAR segment's block statement opens (the extent-1 splat sources) no longer rides the unfiltered kernel-level frame list (its close refused 'a partial has no lowered value at the chunk back edge' before the restructured region ever lowered), and the no-pass fallback vl is the block extent's own chunk plan: the scalar-opened chunk ran 32 lanes over extent-1 staged slots and its stores overflowed them -- nansum's executed sum came out 0.0 for a 0.787 input (reproduced with a QEMU observation harness, root-caused to the mask reload reading the start-splat's zeros). (3) The region close drops stale chunk-body bindings (pure trees re-materialize; merged partials and liveouts rebind at the exit) and clears the chunk so suffix-level control flow stops threading per-chunk candidates; each if-arm starts from the pre-if merge-slot state (the else arm previously branched to the join with the THEN arm's scan carry); a restructured if's arm-close join values are nested-liveout uses of the arm's passes; a chunk open resets the frames' per-chunk slot state. (4) A 16-bit float scan's carry computes at fp32 (the target's e16 float lanes are fp16; a bf16 scan's inner adds silently reinterpreted the bits -- masked_cumsum bf16 executed garbage). All 58 identities of the 13 owned operators now compile to artifacts (0 refusals); all 54 census identities of the three classes execute and compare PASS at 1 and 4 workers (108 runs) under their declared policies; three earlier rounds' stale boundary records were updated to the moved boundaries; a new regression test covers the carried-update shape, the join-ordering failure mode with the TIR/MIR verifiers accepting, and the two executed miscompile traps, with controls that the recognition is not over-broad.
